name: Radiation Electronics Inc
old_description: As manufacturer representatives, we are well established for expanding brand awareness of technology products across our territory on your behalf.  We address a variety of technology markets and industries, including: Avionics; Mil/Aero and Defense; Enterprise Computing and Networking; and Embedded Computing for Industrial, Medical, Telecom and Transportation. We have a full understanding of the driving forces behind the latest technologies.  If you are a manufacturer of technology products, looking for sales representation, choose us and we will align your products around our network to increase your market share.
about:
Radiation Electronics Inc. (REI) operates as an electronics manufacturers' representative firm headquartered in Harrison, New York, serving the metropolitan New York territory including New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Connecticut. The company has been in business for over 50 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details are not disclosed.

REI represents a portfolio of technology manufacturers across product categories including embedded and rugged computers, network hardware, RF over fiber links, timing and synchronization equipment, avionics databus interfaces, storage devices, and test & measurement instrumentation. The firm's professional sales engineers provide technical sales support, market development, and product line management for principals such as APACER, Astronics Ballard Technology, Brandywine Communications, GIG-OPTICS, General Micro Systems, Moog-Protokraft, NEXCOM, Vialite, PPM, VIAVI, and Wolf Advanced Technology.

The company serves customers in avionics, defense/military/aerospace, enterprise computing and networking, industrial, medical, space, and telecom/transportation markets. Its customer base includes engineers and developers, IT professionals, manufacturers, research and development organizations, and service providers.

REI emphasizes its long-term relationships with both principals and customers, professional and ethical business conduct, and a deep understanding of the driving forces behind the latest technologies to align products with market needs.
